verdict.rationale: Quo's pricing page lists 'Phone menus' alongside custom ring orders and call transfers, and the homepage claims it routes incoming calls to the right person and lets a team share one number. That is first-party evidence of an IVR-style capability, but only as bare feature-list mentions. Nothing describes how menu options are configured or how they map to team groups. Missing for 10: documentation of keypress-option setup (e.g. 'press 1 for sales'), evidence that menu options route to teams or groups rather than individuals, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
